Your October budget now has a budget page. Open the note and switch to **Page** to see it.

**What it shows:**
- **Total vs limit:** 12 357,50 kr spent, 2 642,50 kr left of your 15 000 kr limit (82% used). A bar fills up by category and the text turns red if you go over.
- **By category:** each category with its total and share of spending. Right now that's housing 9 500 kr, transport 970, food 1 349,50, subscriptions 278 and fun 260.
- **Latest expenses:** the 8 most recent.
- **Add an expense:** near the top so it's easy to reach on your phone. Type the amount (412,50 works), what it was, then tap a category button or type a new one. The date starts as today but you can change it. Each expense you add becomes a new row in the note.

**What I changed in the note:** the page needs a table, so I turned your list into one with Date, Item, Category and Amount columns. All 8 expenses are still there and nothing else changed. The page keeps the 15 000 kr limit in its own settings, and you can change it at the bottom of the page. The "Limit this month" line in the note stays as it was, but editing that line won't change what the page uses.

  "guide": "# Building Amber Notes pages

A page turns a note into a small app: a habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a reading log. The note's markdown is the data and stays the source of truth: the person can always flip to Text and see and edit every row. The page is a view and a remote control for that data. Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.

## The contract
